senses.gloss: tsitsi, a derisive imitation of the sound ts (צ) in certain formulas of benedictions.
units: Men. 42ᵃ (ref. to a person who had said the benediction לעשות ציצית) מאי צ׳ שמענא הכי what is that tsitsi I heard here? Ber. 42ᵃ (ref. to the benediction המוציא … הארץ) מאי צ׳ וכ׳ (Ms. K. ציו ציו).
